context:
Goal: keep the global CLAUDE.md small, with each rule loading where it must act.
Problem (rule): the audit moves one Tokens rule into a skill, and nothing moves without your sign-off.
Based on (ruling): your 12:38 and 12:40 CST Nov 11 words on moving sections, "it would need my sign off".
Based on (measured): the plan's word counts, and its load test: a rule that stops an act must load before that act.
Departs from: main — read-the-map-first (12 words) moves to skill plain-english-map (the code map in docs/map).
Meanwhile: nothing moves before your answer, and the moves also wait on the split of the guard test file into one file per rule.

options.how: The lane moves the text as the plan proposes.
options.label: Accept the move
options.lose: The rule loads only in repos with a map, and only when that skill fires.

options.gain: The rule loads in every session, before any act.
options.label: Keep it global
options.lose: No words leave the global file.

reply: Closed by triage 11:42 CST Nov 12, staleness pass: you already ruled this on Oct 28 13:26 CDT (waiting page item 23, pick b, in the map step c146): read-the-map-first lives in the map skill's description plus one anchored sentence in CLAUDE.md. Nothing has changed since, so it stays.
title: Where read-the-map-first lives
why: The lane's pick: the rule matters only in repos that have a map.
